/**
 * Vault Roomba (Google Drive Native Apps Script Edition)
 * Sweeps the root of "My Drive" into organized subfolders.
 */

const TARGET_FOLDER_NAME = "meow-vault";

const ROUTING_RULES = {
  "writing-sensei": [
    MimeType.GOOGLE_DOCS,
    MimeType.PLAIN_TEXT,
    MimeType.RTF,
    MimeType.MICROSOFT_WORD,
    MimeType.OPENDOCUMENT_TEXT
  ],
  "docs-dono": [
    MimeType.GOOGLE_SHEETS,
    MimeType.GOOGLE_SLIDES,
    MimeType.PDF,
    MimeType.CSV,
    MimeType.MICROSOFT_EXCEL,
    MimeType.MICROSOFT_POWERPOINT
  ],
  "art-chan": [
    MimeType.GOOGLE_DRAWINGS,
    MimeType.PNG,
    MimeType.JPEG,
    MimeType.BMP,
    MimeType.GIF,
    MimeType.SVG
  ],
  "library-senpai": [
    "application/epub+zip",
    "application/x-mobipocket-ebook",
    "application/x-cbr",
    "application/x-cbz"
  ],
  "scripts-senpai": [
    MimeType.GOOGLE_APPS_SCRIPT,
    MimeType.JAVASCRIPT,
    MimeType.CSS,
    MimeType.HTML,
    "application/json",
    "text/x-python"
  ]
};

// Map file extensions as fallback when MIME type is generic
const EXTENSION_MAP = {
  "writing-sensei": [".md", ".txt", ".docx", ".doc", ".rtf"],
  "library-senpai": [".epub", ".mobi", ".azw3", ".cbr", ".cbz"],
  "docs-dono": [".pdf", ".djvu", ".csv", ".xlsx", ".pptx"],
  "art-chan": [".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".webp", ".gif", ".psd", ".clip", ".svg"],
  "scripts-senpai": [".py", ".ps1", ".sh", ".js", ".json", ".yaml", ".yml"]
};

function sweepMyDrive() {
  Logger.log("[*] Starting My Drive Cloud Sweep...");
  
  // 1. Get or create root target vault
  const vaultFolder = getOrCreateFolder(DriveApp.getRootFolder(), TARGET_FOLDER_NAME);
  
  // 2. Pre-create category destination folders
  const categoryFolders = {};
  for (const category of Object.keys(ROUTING_RULES)) {
    categoryFolders[category] = getOrCreateFolder(vaultFolder, category);
  }

  // 3. Scan ONLY loose files directly at the root of "My Drive"
  const files = DriveApp.getRootFolder().getFiles();
  let movedCount = 0;

  while (files.hasNext()) {
    const file = files.next();
    const fileName = file.getName();
    const mimeType = file.getMimeType();
    
    const targetCategory = resolveCategory(fileName, mimeType);
    
    if (targetCategory && categoryFolders[targetCategory]) {
      const destFolder = categoryFolders[targetCategory];
      
      // Move file: add to destination, remove from root
      destFolder.addFile(file);
      DriveApp.getRootFolder().removeFile(file);
      
      Logger.log(`[MOVED] "${fileName}" (${mimeType}) -> ${TARGET_FOLDER_NAME}/${targetCategory}/`);
      movedCount++;
    }
  }

  Logger.log(`[*] Sweep complete. Total files moved: ${movedCount}`);
}

function resolveCategory(fileName, mimeType) {
  // Check MIME types first
  for (const [category, mimeTypes] of Object.entries(ROUTING_RULES)) {
    if (mimeTypes.includes(mimeType)) {
      return category;
    }
  }
  
  // Fallback to extension match
  const lowerName = fileName.toLowerCase();
  for (const [category, extensions] of Object.entries(EXTENSION_MAP)) {
    for (const ext of extensions) {
      if (lowerName.endsWith(ext)) {
        return category;
      }
    }
  }
  return null;
}

function getOrCreateFolder(parentFolder, folderName) {
  const folders = parentFolder.getFoldersByName(folderName);
  if (folders.hasNext()) {
    return folders.next();
  }
  return parentFolder.createFolder(folderName);
}

"# 🧹 Vault Roomba 🐾

```
      /\_/\
    =( °w° )=   *sweep sweep*
      )   (  //
     (__|__)//
```

Welcome to **Vault Roomba (Google Drive Native Apps Script Edition)**! This cute little script automatically tidies up the root of your Google Drive ("My Drive") by sweeping loose files into organized, category-specific subfolders under a main vault directory.

## 🌟 Features

- **Root Sweep Only**: Safely scans and handles files located strictly at the root level of your Drive, leaving existing folders untouched.
- **Cute Categories (Kawaiian Style)**:
  - `writing-sensei` 📝 (Google Docs, TXT, Word documents, etc.)
  - `docs-dono` 📊 (Sheets, Slides, PDFs, CSVs, Excel, PowerPoint)
  - `art-chan` 🎨 (Drawings, PNG, JPEG, SVG, WebP, PSD, etc.)
  - `library-senpai` 📚 (EPUB, MOBI, CBR, CBZ ebooks)
  - `scripts-senpai` 💻 (Apps Script, JS, Python, HTML, CSS, JSON, YAML)
- **MIME and Extension Fallback**: Resolves categorization using MIME type matching, falling back to extension-based rules when necessary.
- **Auto-Provisioning**: Automatically creates the main target folder (`meow-vault`) and category folders if they do not exist.

## 🚀 Setup & Usage

1. Open [Google Apps Script](https://script.google.com/).
2. Create a new project.
3. Paste the contents of [Code.gs](file:///Code.gs) into the editor.
4. Run the `sweepMyDrive` function! (You will need to authorize Google Drive permissions on the first run).

---
*Made with 💖 and 🐾*
"
